name: Node Service & Telemetry Management
description: Agent capabilities for remotely managing Tier 1-4 execution services (nerve, envoy) across the NATS mesh.
context: QuanuX nodes run distinct telemetry services depending on their hardware tier.
Tier 1 control nodes run the Python Fast-Nerve ('nerve' service).
Tier 2-4 bare-metal edge nodes run the C++ Native Envoy ('envoy' service).
Agents MUST NOT attempt to SSH into Tier 2-4 nodes to restart services, as they are isolated.
To manage a remote service, use: 'quanuxctl telemetry <start|stop|restart|status> --node <HOSTNAME> --service <nerve|envoy>'
Example: To restart the Native Envoy on an edge node named 'core-edge-01', run: 'quanuxctl telemetry restart --node core-edge-01 --service envoy'
The command publishes instructions over the NATS grid, and the target node's local mechanism executes the systemctl command natively.

Behind the scenes, the Native Envoy uses a 'Sudoers Gasket' for passwordless systemd control, and a 'Kamikaze ACK' sequence ensuring it flushes its NATS acknowledgement prior to OS-level self-termination.
